This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

I hereby give notice for information of General Public that as per Secretary's Decision No. 2024/12/05/50 dated 05.12.2024, roads and paths included in this Schedule should be declared as roads and paths belonged to Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha in terms of task assigned to Pradeshiya Sabha in Sabaragamuwa Province by the series of orders with regard to publishing notices indicating register and caused to be prepared plans for roads and paths maintained by Sabaragamuwa Province having been declared in Extraordinary Gazette Notiﬁ cation No. 2316/20 and dated 24th of January, 2023 by Hon. Governor in Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council read as Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987.

If opinion of party claiming to a land that is any road or a path included in the said schedule is inclusive in any partition of land, I hereby notify that actions should be taken to institute an action in the appropriate court before expiration of a period of three months from this Notice.

Further, I notify that every road and path included in the said schedule which hasn't been instituted an action before expiration of the said period of three months should be considered as a road or a path belonged to Galigamuwa Pradeshiya Sabha.
Nൺඏඈൽൺ Kඋංඌඁൺඇඍඁං, Secretary and Executing Oﬃ cer for Powers, Duties and Functions, Pradeshiya Sabha - Galigamuwa.
Head Oﬃ ce at Pradeshiya Sabha - Galigamuwa,Pitagaldeniya.07th January 2025.
